title: User function body with early-return followed by terminal return — Tier 4.3 pass 20 canonicalizer
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Concurrent assign `y <= early(sel, a, b);` where `early(s,x,z)` has body `if s = '1' then return x; end if; return z;`. Pre-pass-20 this shape fell to UserFunctionBlackBox because the leading if lacks an else — the terminal-shape gate expected a single IfStructure with an else. Pass 20's canonicalizer folds this into `if s = '1' then return x else return z end if` before the terminal check, then TryInlineIfElseAsMux handles it. Same waveform as case 152 (fn-inline-mux2); different source pattern.
